title: Modular Equations
statementMd:
Last week, Hamed learned about a new type of equations in his math class called Modular Equations. Lets define $*i*$ modulo $*j*$ as the remainder of division of $*i*$ by $*j*$ and denote it by ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dd2b46f89067e3a9d9987c4263de702dd7518fa7.png). A Modular Equation, as Hamed's teacher described, is an equation of the form ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc4bae676fb9b7279f0b9e6781d3d2d6abf86586.png) in which $*a*$ and $*b*$ are two non-negative integers and $*x*$ is a variable. We call a positive integer $*x*$ for which ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc4bae676fb9b7279f0b9e6781d3d2d6abf86586.png) a solution of our equation.

Hamed didn't pay much attention to the class since he was watching a movie. He only managed to understand the definitions of these equations.

Now he wants to write his math exercises but since he has no idea how to do that, he asked you for help. He has told you all he knows about Modular Equations and asked you to write a program which given two numbers $*a*$ and $*b*$ determines how many answers the Modular Equation ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc4bae676fb9b7279f0b9e6781d3d2d6abf86586.png) has.

## Input

In the only line of the input two space-separated integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($0 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{9}$) are given.

## Output

If there is an infinite number of answers to our equation, print "infinity" (without the quotes). Otherwise print the number of solutions of the Modular Equation ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc4bae676fb9b7279f0b9e6781d3d2d6abf86586.png).

## Note

In the first sample the answers of the Modular Equation are 8 and 16 since ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6f5ff39ebd209bf990adaf91f4b82f9687097224.png)
statementZhMd:
上周，Hamed 在数学课上学习了一种新类型的方程，称为模方程。我们将 $*i*$ 除以 $*j*$ 所得的余数定义为 $*i*$ 模 $*j*$，并记作 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dd2b46f89067e3a9d9987c4263de702dd7518fa7.png)。正如 Hamed 的老师所描述的，模方程是形如 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc4bae676fb9b7279f0b9e6781d3d2d6abf86586.png) 的方程，其中 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 是两个非负整数，$*x*$ 是一个变量。对于使得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc4bae676fb9b7279f0b9e6781d3d2d6abf86586.png) 成立的正整数 $*x*$，我们称其为该方程的一个解。

Hamed 上课时一直在看电影，没有太认真听讲。他只理解了这类方程的定义。

现在，他想完成数学练习，但由于完全不知道该怎么做，所以向你寻求帮助。他告诉了你所有关于模方程的知识，并请你编写一个程序：给定两个数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$，确定模方程 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc4bae676fb9b7279f0b9e6781d3d2d6abf86586.png) 有多少个解。

## 输入格式

输入的唯一一行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$0 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

如果该方程有无穷多个解，输出 `infinity`（不含引号）。否则，输出模方程 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc4bae676fb9b7279f0b9e6781d3d2d6abf86586.png) 的解的数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，模方程的解为 8 和 16，因为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6f5ff39ebd209bf990adaf91f4b82f9687097224.png)。
